name: [BETA] Festival Tycoon
desc:
Build your own music festival with The Chainsmokers’ Festival Tycoon. Along the way, you will explore the Islands, build a roller coaster, complete a daring quest and boogie it down while creating the most fantastic music festival ever!

🎩 Earn incredible FREE avatar items 

🏆 Don't forget to like and favorite the game

💃 Dance to your favorite Chainsmokers songs

🛍️ Shop The Chainsmokers & other avatar accessories to show off your best festival apparel!

🎮 Available for PC, XBOX, Tablet and Mobile

💾 Don’t worry, all progress is autosaved so you can pick the party back up at any time!
